source: UrbanTALES idealized building arrays; profile-*.csv and metadata_ideal.json
target: Height-weighted mean of profile U (horizontally averaged wind speed) from z=0 to mean building height for each simulation case
hierarchy: 224 cases = 112 layouts x 2 wind directions; 112 layouts = 16 plan families x 7 height patterns (CL/HR/SM x 28/56 + uniform)
grouping: PRIMARY: family_id (footprint + plan-area density). SECONDARY: layout_id (interpolation only).
label_note: configuration follows the folder code; the catalogue Config label has CL and SM swapped and is kept as configuration_metadata_label.
weather_note: UrbanTALES metadata provides wind direction but no independent weather time-series inputs for this static profile target.
